user.description: Sign in with your Plejd account. Your credentials are used to fetch the site's devices and crypto key, then control happens locally over Bluetooth.

site.description: Choose which Plejd site to add.

reauth_confirm.description: Re-enter the password for your Plejd account ({email}).

reconfigure.title: Update Plejd device list
reconfigure.description: Re-fetch all devices and scenes for this site from the Plejd cloud. Use this after adding new Plejd devices in the Plejd app.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to reach the Plejd cloud. Please try again.
error.no_sites: No Plejd sites were found for this account.

schedules.title: Plejd schedules
schedules.description: Add a weekly on-device schedule that runs a scene, or remove existing ones. These run on the Plejd devices themselves, so they work even when Home Assistant is offline.

add_device.title: Add a device
add_device.description: Pick a Plejd device that's currently broadcasting as unprovisioned nearby.

add_device_details.title: Add a device
add_device_details.description: Name the device found at {address}, and optionally put it in a new room.

dashboard.title: Plejd dashboard
dashboard.description: Show the Plejd dashboard in the sidebar (left navigation menu).

holiday_mode.title: Holiday mode
holiday_mode.description: While the Holiday mode switch is on and the time of day is within this window, a random subset of the lights below turns on and off to make the home look occupied. Leave lights empty to use every Plejd light.

error.no_free_slots: All 20 schedule slots are in use.
error.scene_required: Pick a scene for the new schedule.
error.days_required: Pick at least one weekday for the new schedule.
error.no_devices_found: No unprovisioned Plejd devices found nearby. Make sure the device is powered and in Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.name_required: Enter a name for the device.
error.no_bluetooth: Bluetooth is not available on this Home Assistant instance. Add a local Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy (in active mode), then try again.
